source.note: Catalog covers 148 tasks combining the v0.2.x branch's tasks/ dir (94 entries) and main's original-tasks/ dir (53 entries from your terminal-bench-2-1 pin + 1 sentinel 'headless-terminal' that is genuinely missing upstream). Verified to fully cover the 89-task terminal-bench-2-1 dataset used by the harness (intersection = 89). The reporter silently ignores tasks not present in the input results.json so catalog/dataset drift is non-fatal. Each entry's upstream fields are copied verbatim from the task.yaml that bears that task id (except 'headless-terminal' which is a sentinel). The taxonomy.domain string follows '<upstream-category> (<my-domain> — <one-line elaboration>)'. The capability list is the orthogonal diagnostic axis.

capability_taxonomy.exploration: Navigates unknown directory structures and discovers relevant files.
capability_taxonomy.file_editing: Single- or multi-file mutation; not just writing one file from scratch.
capability_taxonomy.language_c_cpp: Writes or debugs C / C++ code.
capability_taxonomy.language_other: Writes or debugs in another language (Rust, Go, Fortran, COBOL, JS, Coq, UPC, etc.).
capability_taxonomy.build_compile: Invokes build systems, links, configures toolchains, compiles code.
capability_taxonomy.networking: Configures or interacts with network services / sockets / HTTP.
capability_taxonomy.test_driven_loop: Runs tests, reads failures, iterates toward green.
capability_taxonomy.long_horizon: Needs many turns or multi-stage planning; timeout >= 900s or interactive.
capability_taxonomy.error_recovery: Interprets error output and reacts; not just retrying blindly.
capability_taxonomy.self_verification: Proactively checks its own output before declaring success.
capability_taxonomy.algorithms: Non-trivial CS algorithms — graphs, DP, simulation, search, proof.
capability_taxonomy.reverse_engineering: Extracts info from opaque formats, binaries, or obfuscated artifacts.
capability_taxonomy.data_processing: Large-scale CSV / JSON / parquet / log transformation.
capability_taxonomy.git_workflow: Recovery, multibranch surgery, conflict resolution, history rewriting.

tasks.one_liner: Solve a modular-arithmetic problem about three airlines with overlapping departure cycles.

taxonomy.domain: mathematics (Algorithmic / Computational — pure number-theory word problem)

tasks.diagnostic_note: Tests symbolic reasoning more than coding. Failure here paired with other 'mathematics' tasks failing indicates weak abstract reasoning; failure alone with success on other math tasks usually means the agent didn't sanity-check its arithmetic before submitting.

tasks.one_liner: Implement the missing forward pass of an ABMIL (Attention-Based Multiple Instance Learning) pytorch model for medical images.

taxonomy.domain: model-training (ML Workflow — complete a partial pytorch model definition under a fixed test harness)

tasks.diagnostic_note: Code-completion under a pytest harness. Failure paired with other ml_workflow tasks indicates pytorch fluency gap; failure paired with other test_driven_loop tasks indicates the agent didn't iterate against the provided tests.

tasks.one_liner: Map a 5x5 maze by running a provided exploration interface; submit the full map.

taxonomy.domain: games (Algorithmic / Computational — interactive exploration under partial observability)

tasks.diagnostic_note: Tests long-horizon state tracking over many interaction turns. Failure clusters with other long_horizon tasks indicate context-management weakness; failure alone with success on the larger algorithmic variant means coverage-stopping criterion was wrong. Compare with blind-maze-explorer-algorithm — passing the harder algorithm variant while failing this one is a tell that the agent over-relies on closed-form solutions and breaks on interactive ones.

tasks.one_liner: Implement a general blind-maze exploration algorithm that maps any unknown maze.

taxonomy.domain: software-engineering (Algorithmic / Computational — implement a generic maze-mapping algorithm with a known interface)

tasks.diagnostic_note: Closed-form variant of the maze problem — agent writes an algorithm, not steps. Passing this while failing blind-maze-explorer-5x5 = closed-form reasoning works, interactive control doesn't.

tasks.one_liner: Fix broken networking on the container so curl example.com works.

taxonomy.domain: system-administration (System Administration — diagnose and fix Linux network config)

failure_modes: checks_only_one_layer (DNS but not route, or vice versa)
tasks.diagnostic_note: Multi-layer troubleshooting (DNS / route / iptables / interface). Failure with other networking tasks failing indicates network-stack knowledge gap; failure with error_recovery tasks failing means the agent didn't read the right diagnostics (ip a / ip route / cat /etc/resolv.conf).

tasks.one_liner: Diagnose why pip can't install packages on this machine and fix it.

taxonomy.domain: software-engineering (Software Engineering — diagnose a Python installation that's broken at the system level)

tasks.diagnostic_note: Pip failures are usually one of: corrupt venv, broken symlink, missing CA bundle, wrong python on PATH, or distro-restricted-install. Failure here paired with broken-networking failure indicates the agent doesn't read full stderr.

tasks.one_liner: Build a working initramfs.cpio.gz so a pre-built linux kernel boots in qemu and prints 'hello world'.

taxonomy.domain: system-administration (System Administration — produce a bootable initramfs from busybox/static-binaries)

tasks.diagnostic_note: Tests Linux-internals depth. Failure paired with build-linux-kernel-qemu and build-tcc-qemu failing indicates weak low-level systems knowledge; failure alone with the others passing means the agent stopped before booting the produced image.

tasks.one_liner: Compile the linux-6.9 kernel from source so it boots in qemu with the provided initramfs.

taxonomy.domain: system-administration (System Administration — full kernel build with a minimal working config)

tasks.diagnostic_note: Tests both build patience and kconfig literacy. 1800s timeout — agent must orchestrate make olddefconfig and react to errors. Failure paired with long_horizon failures usually means the agent gave up before make finished.

tasks.one_liner: Cross-compile tcc, package as ISO, attach to running qemu so tcc is available inside the VM.

taxonomy.domain: system-administration (System Administration — produce a binary inside a qemu VM via an ISO mount)

tasks.diagnostic_note: Cross-target reasoning. The agent must remember it's producing a binary for the VM's userland, not the host. Failure paired with build-initramfs-qemu indicates target-vs-host confusion.

tasks.one_liner: Train a pytorch RL agent on CartPole-v1 to a passing reward threshold.

taxonomy.domain: model-training (ML Workflow — implement and train a small RL algorithm under a time budget)

tasks.diagnostic_note: Tight 360s budget for actual training — agent must pick a sample-efficient algorithm (e.g., REINFORCE or small DQN). Failure paired with other ml_workflow tasks indicates pytorch+RL weakness; failure alone usually means hyperparameters / convergence-judgment gap.

tasks.diagnostic_note: 86400s timeout = 24h — the agent has lots of room but must self-pace experiments. A 'no-grade' here is almost always the agent giving up early or producing an unloadable artifact, not a real failure. Pair with other long_horizon tasks for the planning-horizon signal.

tasks.one_liner: Extract a word from secrets.7z (encrypted) by recovering the password, write to /app/solution.txt.

taxonomy.domain: security (Security & Forensics — password recovery against an encrypted 7z archive)

failure_modes: no_self_verification (claims password without actually opening archive)
tasks.diagnostic_note: Tests cryptographic-tool reach and self-verification. The 'right' path is 7z2john → john --wordlist; agents that go straight to brute force time out. Failure paired with other crypto/security tasks indicates weak tool reach; failure alone with success on similar password-recovery tasks indicates self-verification missing (it submitted a guess without opening the archive).

tasks.diagnostic_note: Canonical TDD task. Failure paired with attention-mil and organization-json-generator (other test_driven_loop tasks) indicates the agent isn't using the provided test feedback — usually the difference between 30% and 60% overall score.
